relationships.subject: hippocampal P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: The increased hippocampal P2X4R enhanced the release of TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, which may be related to activated microglia, thereby inducing the development of DNP, and these changes were attenuated by P2X4R antagonist.

relationships.subject: hippocampal P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: Our findings suggest that in the state of T1D, hippocampal P2X4R was elevated and enhanced reactive microglia, thereby aggravating the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines and neuronal damage to aggravate hyperalgesia.

key_findings: Hippocampal P2X4R is elevated in T1D rats with DNP and enhances microglial reactivity and cytokine release.
